text_block_list.text:
Since Marvelous Sunday was in a slump,
we came to the shrine for a change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, shrines are marvelous☆
My wishes are spinning 'round, itching to burst out★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "So many strong feelings! It feels like lots of marvelous things are coming together☆ Let's go look for them!"

While taking a stroll with Marvelous Sunday,
we came out into the woods behind the shrine grounds. However...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: It's kinda chilly here☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Ah. Trainer, look!

I look in the direction Marvelous Sunday is pointing.
There, a black mist seemed to be squirming.
Aaagh... Aa-me-aa...

A chill ran down her spine, making every hair on her body stand on end.
Her instincts rang alarms of danger.
Yet, Marvelous Sunday—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you over there. What's the matter?
Tell me all about it☆
A-Aaaagh-croak-aaaaah...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I see. You're having doubts, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Still, try to think reeeally hard, okay? There must have been a time when you were shining too☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
âSee? You were marvelous too,â
I'm sure you'll be marvelous "next time" too!â

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
So, don't be scared, okay?
Let's summon our courage and move forward☆
Before I knew it, the black shadow was nowhere to be seen.
choice_data_list: Was that just now... a dream...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Looks like she's blown past her doubts ☆
Ahaha, that's great~ ★

Our outing ended with the mystery still unsolved.
Perhaps thanks to what happened, Marvelous Sunday
was able to get her groove back.
Ah... aah? Aaaah, aaaagh...!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to rush, okay?
Take your time and remember—

Ooooh... Raaage-ooh...!
Grudge grudge grudge grudge grudge grudge-ooooh...!

The wind howls low, and tension fills the air.
I have a really bad feeling about this...!

Taking Marvelous Sunday by the hand, I run with
single-minded focus. Eventually, we emerge into a familiar view.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Did I do something bad...?

It remains unknown what that dark shadow was.
However, Marvelous Sunday
was never able to regain her top form...
